Name: Vikas Taneja
Designation: Managing Director and Senior Partner, Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
Bio:
Vikas Taneja is a Founder of Plaksha. He is a Managing Director and Senior Partner with the Boston Consulting Group. He is the global leader of BCG's GrowthTech business. Vikas is also on the Global Leadership Team of BCG's Technology, Media, and Telecom practice. Vikas was previously the leader of BCG's Marketing and Sales practices in the Americas and the Global Head of the Sales and Go-to-market topic for BCG.

Vikas's commercial focus has been on achieving profitable growth at major corporations. He has led major programs to improve business performance through improving sales productivity, product portfolio improvements, process reengineering, and organization restructuring. Vikas has worked extensively with software, technology, and IT services companies on topics such as improving software sales process and compressing turnaround times, sales growth, sales productivity, and metrics.

Prior to joining BCG, Vikas worked at ARCH Technology Partners where he evaluated and helped commercialize new technologies emerging from University of Chicago's academic labs and medical school. Vikas has also worked in the Information and Technology group at McKinsey and Co.

Vikas received his MBA with Honors in Economics and Finance from the University of Chicago. He also holds a Bachelor of Arts and Sciences in Computer Systems Engineering and Economic Development from Stanford University.

Vikas previously led the Boston chapter of Pratham, an India-based organization that has worked with over 4 million children to help them achieve literacy and basic mathematics skills.
